name: Gods-Eye-View
description: God's Eye View is a browser-based 3D globe for exploring public aircraft, ship, satellite, earthquake, traffic, camera, radio, fire, and other geospatial data. This image packages the upstream v0.1.1 application and its required Vite proxy server. It starts without API keys. Optional provider credentials unlock additional data and voice features. Intended for a trusted home LAN; the application has no user authentication.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: God's Eye View web interface. Keep it restricted to a trusted LAN.

variables.name: Cesium ion Token
variables.description: Optional client-visible assets:read token for photorealistic 3D and world terrain. Apply URL restrictions and provider quotas.

variables.name: Google Maps API Key
variables.description: Optional client-visible key for direct Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles and place search. Apply HTTP-referrer and API restrictions plus provider quotas.

variables.name: OpenAI API Key
variables.description: Optional server-side key for realtime voice and AI HUD summaries. Configure provider-side spending limits before use.

variables.name: OpenAI Requests per Minute per Client
variables.description: Process-local per-client limit for OpenAI-backed endpoints. This is not a billing cap.

variables.name: Google Requests per Minute per Client
variables.description: Process-local per-client limit for Google Places requests. This is not a billing cap.

variables.name: AISStream API Key
variables.description: Optional server-side key for live vessel positions.

variables.name: NASA FIRMS Map Key
variables.description: Optional server-side key for live active-fire detections.

variables.name: TomTom API Key
variables.description: Optional server-side key for live traffic-flow speeds. Keyless traffic remains simulated.

variables.name: TomTom Daily Tile Budget
variables.description: Application-level UTC-day limit for TomTom upstream tile requests. This is not a provider billing cap.

variables.name: OpenSky Authentication Mode
variables.description: Use anon without credentials. Set oauth when configuring both OpenSky client fields.

variables.name: OpenSky Client ID
variables.description: Optional OAuth client ID for additional OpenSky polling credits. Also set mode to oauth and provide the client secret.

variables.name: OpenSky Client Secret
variables.description: Optional OAuth client secret for OpenSky. Also set mode to oauth and provide the client ID.

variables.name: Launch Library 2 Token
variables.description: Optional server-side token for a higher space-missions request allowance.
